Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.combat

Record Class AttackProfile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.combat.AttackProfile
Record Components:
accuracy - attacker's accuracy rating
minDamage - smallest damage roll
maxDamage - largest damage roll
damageType - kind of damage
critPercent - percent chance of a critical hit
onHitEffect - effect that may be inflicted on a damaging hit, or null
onHitPercent - percent chance of inflicting the effect
effectDuration - duration of the inflicted effect
effectMagnitude - magnitude of the inflicted effect
verb - how the attack is described, e.g. "hit" or "bite"
public record AttackProfile(int accuracy, int minDamage, int maxDamage, DamageType damageType, int critPercent, EffectType onHitEffect, int onHitPercent, int effectDuration, int effectMagnitude, String verb) extends Record
Everything about one attack that the attacker contributes: how accurate it is, how hard it hits, and what it may inflict.
